summary: Iter122 (feature-add, not bugfix) verified via 18 pytest cases + a live Playwright smoke on the web preview. All 18 iter122 pytest cases PASS (100%). Feature 1 (editorial guidelines): confirmed presence of 'LINEA EDITORIALE — IMPARZIALITÀ E NEUTRALITÀ' (server.py:4299) and 'LINEA EDITORIALE — VERIFICA IMPARZIALITÀ' (server.py:4749) blocks; verified political-axis enumeration (destra/sinistra/populista/sovranista/progressista/conservatore), banned-tone quotes ('ovviamente sbagliato', 'come al solito'), SIMMETRIA DELLE PARTI rule, MINORI E VITTIME skip contract, coraggioso/folle asymmetry example, and complottiste/pseudoscienza rejection. Feature 2 (native store-review): reviewManager.ts exports {markSessionOpen, recordAction, maybePrompt}, uses expo-store-review with Platform.OS==='web' no-op guard, all four gate constants pinned (MIN_SESSIONS=3, MIN_ACTIONS=5, MIN_DAYS_SINCE_INSTALL=3, MIN_DAYS_BETWEEN_PROMPTS=120), expo-store-review ~9.0.9 in package.json, markSessionOpen() called at mount in _layout.tsx:97, and recordAction fires from all three feud/[id].tsx sites (vote L400, comment L419, reply L480). Live Playwright smoke at https://feud-admin-panel.preview.emergentagent.com (mobile 390x844): app boots to login screen, ZERO modal/dialog overlays, ZERO native alerts captured, ZERO rating-related text in DOM, localStorage shows review_session_count='1' proving markSessionOpen fired, review_last_prompt key ABSENT proving maybePrompt no-op'd on web. Regression: 70 passing + 4 failing + 3 xfailed across iter113-121 + mentions_and_blocks — the 4 failures are all in test_iter114_hype_block_filter.py and are pre-existing environmental data-crowding flakes (hype endpoint returns top-8 and seeded feuds get pushed out by newer higher-ranked feuds), NOT related to iter122 (which is content-only + isolated new util file).

minor.issue: test_iter114_hype_block_filter.py 4 failures — flaky when the top-8 hype window is saturated by higher-ranked production feuds so freshly-seeded feuds never appear in the ranking baseline. Not a regression from iter122. Consider bumping hype limit param in the test helper (_hype_ids at L81) or making test seed feuds with higher engagement to enter top-8. Reproducible with EXPO_BACKEND_URL + MONGO_URL env set.

action_items: None blocking iter122. Optional: fix test_iter114_hype_block_filter.py by passing ?limit=100 to /api/feuds/hype in _hype_ids() so the four assertions stop being crowded out by production data. This is a test-only flake, no product bug.
critical_code_review_comments: reviewManager.ts:44-51 — readNum/writeNum swallow storage errors silently. On a real device if AsyncStorage is corrupted the review gate is effectively reset to 0/never, which is safe (no false prompts) but the counter will never advance either. Consider a single warn on the first failure to surface storage regressions during beta.

reviewManager.ts:82-89 — Promise.all([hasAction, isAvailableAsync]) inside a try/catch is fine, but on Android hasAction() takes ~200ms cold. Because maybePrompt() is called synchronously from onPress paths (vote/comment/reply in feud/[id].tsx), it will fire this Play-store IPC on every action even before the sessions/actions gate is reached. Micro-optimisation: gate the sessions/actions/dates FIRST (they are AsyncStorage-only) and only call the native availability check as the last step. Non-blocking.

server.py:4331-4333 — the minors-skip rule embeds a JSON literal `{"skip": true, "reason": "minori/vittime tutelate"}` in the prompt. Verify the downstream parser at ai_generate_feud actually honours a top-level `skip: true` payload (i.e. doesn't try to build a feud from a skip envelope). Present code path likely does — but flag for main-agent unit coverage in a future iter.

success_rate.backend: 100% on iter122 acceptance (18/18); iter113-121+mentions regression: 70 passed / 4 failed / 3 xfailed — the 4 failures are pre-existing iter114 hype top-8 crowding flakes, unrelated to iter122.
success_rate.frontend: 100% (web smoke: no popup, no error, session-counter localStorage key present, last-prompt key absent as expected on web)

seed_data_creation: None. Test file only asserts source-level presence (no DB writes) plus live GETs on /api/ and /api/feuds. Playwright smoke opened the login screen without authenticating.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter122 is content-only for the AI system prompts + a brand-new isolated util file. The 4 iter114 hype failures are a long-standing test-side flake caused by the /api/feuds/hype endpoint returning only top-8 items ranked by engagement — seeded 'HYPE-TEST-*' feuds only have 2 votes and get evicted by production feuds with higher engagement. Fix is trivial (add ?limit=100 to _hype_ids) but out of scope for iter122. To run the iter122 acceptance suite standalone: `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iter122_editorial_and_review.py -v`. To run the full iter113-121 regression: set MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, ADMIN_KEY from /app/backend/.env AND set EXPO_BACKEND_URL=https://feud-admin-panel.preview.emergentagent.com before pytest. reviewManager cannot be truly exercised via web preview — real device required.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — iter122 is a feature addition with no reported bug. Editorial prompt guidelines were verified present via 8 substring assertions; reviewManager wiring verified via 6 source assertions + a live Playwright DOM/localStorage inspection that confirmed session-tracking works and no store-review UI leaks onto the web build.
